mission: After every fleet sandbox test, isolate failed capability contracts, apply only bounded test-backed repairs, retest the affected capability and bot, then rerun the fleet until all declared capability contracts pass or a real blocker is recorded.
repair_order: extract exact failed capabilities and failure reasons
prefer one shared deterministic repair over repeated bot-specific patches
run known idempotent compatibility repairers when their patterns apply
repeat while failure count is shrinking
forbidden_repairs: weakening or deleting a failing test
marking a capability passed without executable evidence

failure_behavior.unknown_or_semantic_gap: leave red, assign a task-scoped gap worker, preserve exact failure evidence, and require a new candidate repair before the next retest
failure_behavior.external_dependency_gap: record blocked dependency/provider/permission state rather than looping blindly
failure_behavior.no_progress: stop the current Actions run after two rounds with no reduction in failed capability count and publish the unresolved queue
failure_behavior.regression: make the regression a permanent fixture and reopen mastery for the affected bot/capability

truth_rule: Repair-until-pass never means fabricate a pass or spin forever. The loop keeps a capability non-passing until executable evidence passes; genuine blockers remain visible and prevent a green result.
